basic_info.description: Situated on a fabulous corner lot across from Terrace Green Park and just blocks from West Portal Avenue, this stunning Spanish Mediterranean residence must be seen.    Walking up the brick walkway will fill you with a sense of calm as you are surrounded by lush landscaping and mature trees. The grand alcove entry, adorned with wrought-iron details, opens to a large foyer. To the right, a spacious living room with a fireplace; to the left, a formal dining room bathed in natural light from windows on three sides.    The thoughtfully designed kitchen features a central island with prep sink, built-in seating with storage, a SubZero refrigerator, and a Wolf range and lots of cabinet space. A bedroom and full bath complete the main level.    Upstairs, the expansive primary suite boasts plenty of closet space and a luxurious ensuite bath. Two additional bedrooms, each with private balconies and a full bath, offer comfort and convenience.  The lower level, added with permits in 2016, includes a wine cellar, wet bar, laundry room, half bath, and a generous media room. Interior access to the garage enhances convenience.  Additional features include a new terracotta roof (2017), backup battery system, EV charger, automatic sprinkler system, driveway gate and so much more.
